brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu is seeking re-election as Israel prepares for polls on October 27, according to Al Jazeera English. The polarising prime minister, Israel's longest-serving leader, has significantly altered the country's institutional landscape during his tenure. His reshaping of state institutions stands as a defining legacy as voters prepare to decide his political future.

The election comes amid deep divisions within Israeli society over Netanyahu's governance and the structural changes implemented under his administration. His candidacy remains central to broader debates about the direction of Israel's democratic institutions and their balance of power.
dek: As Israel heads to the polls on October 27, its polarising and longest-serving prime minister is seeking re-election.
title: Netanyahu reshapes Israel's institutions ahead of election bid
